# RouterIPHub - Complete Programmatic Technical Knowledgebase
> Uncompressed technical dataset of router default gateways, hardware models, factory credentials, and network configuration profiles.

Date: 2026-11-11
Website: https://routeriphub.com

## 1. Gateway IP Directory
- [192.168.1.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-1-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Netgear, ASUS, Linksys, Cisco, Verizon Fios, Ubiquiti. Default credentials: admin / admin or admin / password.
- [192.168.0.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-0-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: TP-Link, D-Link, Arris, Sky Broadband, Virgin Media. Default credentials: admin / admin (or created on first boot).
- [10.0.0.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/10-0-0-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24 standard local allocation). Brands: Xfinity (Comcast), Apple AirPort, Cisco, Spectrum. Default credentials: admin / password.
- [192.168.1.254 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-1-254/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: AT&T Fiber (BGW320), BT Smart Hub (UK), Plusnet, 2Wire. Default credentials: admin / Printed Access Code.
- [192.168.2.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-2-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Belkin, SMC, Bell Home Hub (Canada), Philips Hue Bridge. Default credentials: admin / [empty] or admin / admin.
- [192.168.8.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-8-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Huawei, GL.iNet Travel Routers, 4G/5G Mobile Hotspots. Default credentials: admin / admin.
- [192.168.10.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-10-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Trendnet, ZyXEL, Motorola Gateway combos. Default credentials: admin / admin.
- [192.168.11.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-11-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Buffalo AirStation, DD-WRT Japanese releases. Default credentials: root / [empty] or admin / password.
- [192.168.12.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-12-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet (KVD21, Arcadyan, Sagemcom). Default credentials: admin / sticker password.
- [192.168.31.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-31-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Xiaomi Mi WiFi, Redmi Routers. Default credentials: admin / set on first boot via miwifi.com.
- [192.168.68.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-68-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: TP-Link Deco Whole Home Mesh Series (X55, XE75, BE85). Default credentials: Managed via TP-Link Deco App.
- [192.168.88.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-88-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: MikroTik RouterBOARD & RouterOS (hAP, RB series). Default credentials: admin / [empty].
- [192.168.100.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-100-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Huawei ONT, Motorola & Arris Cable Modems, Virgin Media Modem Mode. Default credentials: admin / admin (or TelecomAdmin).
- [192.168.178.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-178-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: AVM FRITZ!Box (7590 AX, 6660 Cable, 5590 Fiber). Default credentials: admin / sticker password.
- [10.0.1.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/10-0-1-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Apple AirPort Extreme, AirPort Time Capsule, Cisco. Default credentials: admin / admin (or configured via AirPort Utility).
- [10.0.0.138 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/10-0-0-138/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Telstra (Australia), Thomson / SpeedTouch, Technicolor. Default credentials: admin / admin.
- [192.168.1.2 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-1-2/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Wi-Fi Range Extenders, Secondary Access Points, Repeater Hubs. Default credentials: admin / admin.
- [192.168.1.250 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-1-250/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: NETGEAR Wi-Fi Range Extenders (EX, EAX, EXS Series). Default credentials: admin / password.
- [192.168.50.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-50-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: ASUS, ASUS ROG, TUF Gaming. Default credentials: admin / admin (or set in AsusWRT).
- [192.168.4.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-4-1/): Subnet 255.255.252.0 (/22 default eero DHCP pool). Brands: Amazon eero Mesh Wi-Fi (eero 6, Pro 6E, Max 7). Default credentials: Managed via Amazon eero Mobile App.
- [192.168.86.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-86-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Google Nest Wifi, Google Wifi. Default credentials: Managed via Google Home App.
- [192.168.3.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-3-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Huawei (WiFi AX2, AX3, AX3 Pro, WiFi Mesh). Default credentials: admin / (configured during Huawei HiLink setup).
- [192.168.112.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-112-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Ubiquiti AmpliFi (AmpliFi Alien, HD, Instant). Default credentials: admin / (set during AmpliFi App setup).
- [192.168.128.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-128-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Cisco Meraki Go (GX20, GX50). Default credentials: Managed via Cisco Meraki Go Cloud App.
- [192.168.212.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-212-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Zyxel Multy (Multy M1, Multy X, Multy Plus). Default credentials: admin / 1234 (or printed on label).
- [10.10.10.1 Guide](https://routeriphub.com/ip/10-10-10-1/): Subnet 255.255.255.0 (/24). Brands: Custom Routers, Modems, Access Points & Enterprise Networks. Default credentials: admin / admin.

Reset: With the router powered ON, press and hold the recessed Reset pinhole on the rear panel with a paperclip for 10 seconds until the Power LED starts blinking amber. Release and wait 2-3 minutes for the factory restart.

## 3. Network Setup & Troubleshooting Guides
- [How Do I Access My Router Settings Page?](https://routeriphub.com/howto/access-my-router-settings-page/): Connect to your home Wi-Fi or LAN, enter your router management IP (192.168.1.1, 192.168.0.1, or 10.0.0.1), find credentials on your label, and resolve rejected logins.
- [Why Is 192.168.1.1 Not Working in My Browser?](https://routeriphub.com/howto/why-is-192-168-1-1-not-working/): Resolve 192.168.1.1 timeouts and site-unreachable errors by checking your local Wi-Fi or Ethernet link, gateway address, VPN, proxy, private DNS, and router status lights.
- [Why Can’t I Access My BT Hub Manager?](https://routeriphub.com/howto/why-cant-i-access-my-bt-hub-manager/): Can't open BT Hub Manager at 192.168.1.254 or bthomehub.home? Resolve HTTPS certificate warnings, VPN/proxy blocks, and settings card admin password errors.
- [How to Change Password of Tenda WiFi Without Entering the Previous Password](https://routeriphub.com/howto/change-tenda-wifi-password-without-previous-password/): Recover Tenda router access via the Tenda WiFi app or 192.168.0.1 web login, or perform a safe 8–10 second factory reset and set a strong new Wi-Fi password.
- [How to Change Your Wi-Fi Name (SSID) & Password](https://routeriphub.com/howto/change-wifi-password/): Update your wireless SSID and switch encryption cleanly to WPA2-PSK (AES) or WPA3-Personal from your router web interface.
- [How to Perform a Clean Router Hard Factory Reset](https://routeriphub.com/howto/30-second-hard-factory-reset/): Recover locked admin passwords cleanly using model-safe pinhole Reset timing without damaging firmware or wiping needed ISP PPPoE logins unexpectedly.
- [How to Connect Two Routers Together (Access Point Mode)](https://routeriphub.com/howto/two-routers-access-point-mode/): Turn any spare wireless router into a wired Access Point via LAN-to-LAN cabling, static IP assignment outside DHCP, and disabled secondary NAT.
- [How to Configure Port Forwarding for Gaming & Servers](https://routeriphub.com/howto/port-forwarding-gaming-servers/): Reserve a static local IP via DHCP, map external TCP/UDP port ranges safely, and verify whether CGNAT blocks inbound connections.
- [How to Change Router DNS for Faster Browsing & Privacy](https://routeriphub.com/howto/change-router-dns/): Configure Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Quad9, or AdGuard DNS once at the router WAN/LAN level to accelerate lookups and filter ads across every home device.
- [How to Set Up a Secure Guest Wi-Fi Network](https://routeriphub.com/howto/guest-wifi-network-setup/): Segment visitors and untrusted IoT gadgets onto an isolated Guest SSID with local-network access blocked so personal laptops and NAS drives stay unreachable.
- [Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) & Wi-Fi 6E 6 GHz Configuration Guide](https://routeriphub.com/howto/wifi-7-6ghz-setup-guide/): Unlock 320 MHz ultra-wide channels, Multi-Link Operation (MLO), and uncongested 6 GHz spectrum while avoiding WPA2 client incompatibility traps.
- [Mesh Wi-Fi Backhaul & Node Placement Optimization](https://routeriphub.com/howto/mesh-wifi-backhaul-optimization/): Maximize real-world mesh throughput on Eero, Orbi, Deco, and Velop systems using Cat6/MoCA wired backhaul, mid-point spacing, and 802.11k/v/r fast roaming.
- [Fiber ONT Setup & ISP Gateway Bridge / IP Passthrough Guide](https://routeriphub.com/howto/fiber-ont-bridge-mode-setup/): Bypass ISP combo gateways cleanly on AT&T Fiber, Verizon Fios, Xfinity, and CenturyLink using IP Passthrough, direct Ethernet ONT handoff, or VLAN 201 tagging.
- [IPv6 Default Gateway Discovery & Link-Local (fe80::1) Guide](https://routeriphub.com/howto/ipv6-default-gateway-discovery/): Learn why IPv6 routers show link-local fe80:: addresses instead of 192.168.1.1, and find your active IPv6 default route on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- [How to Flush DNS Cache on Windows, Mac, and Chrome](https://routeriphub.com/howto/how-to-flush-dns-cache/): Purge outdated or corrupted DNS records across Windows 11/10, macOS, and Google Chrome using ipconfig /flushdns, terminal commands, and internal host cache reset.
- [Which Port Do I Plug My Router Into on an AT&T Gateway?](https://routeriphub.com/howto/which-port-plug-router-att-gateway/): Step-by-step wiring guide for connecting a third-party router to an AT&T BGW320 or BGW210 gateway, choosing 5Gb vs 1Gb ports, and enabling IP Passthrough.
